scenarios.title: C｜讨论之后怎么办
scenarios.setting: 在“室友拖欠房租”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“讨论之后怎么办”。

turns.text: I’m really sorry. I don’t want you to have to cover my rent.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I can cover it this time, but I can’t do that every month.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can cover it this time, but I can’t do that every month.
